arguments.heading: What happened at the argument
paragraphs: Ms. Freeland argued the district court felt bound by a policy statement.
She claimed this prevented application of the Booker decision.
The resulting sentence exceeded the jury verdict maximum by six years.
Ms. Kruger argued the relevant statutes do not govern initial sentencing.
